page: Amazon Web Services c9g.12xlarge is a compute-optimized server powered by the AWS Graviton Gen9 processor family. It features 48 dedicated physical cores utilizing the ARM64 architecture with the Neoverse-V3 ARMv9 design. Operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, each core has a dedicated thread, providing 48 vCPUs. The processor configuration includes 64 KB of L1D cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache. The system is provisioned with 96.0 GB of memory, resulting in a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is established with a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong compute and memory performance. The server achieves top-tier status in single-threaded gzip compression, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Geekbench multi-core tests, including software compilation and image processing. Memory performance is notable, with Passmark memory scores and read-only memory bandwidth tests placing in the top tier and top 25% respectively. Database and key-value store operations are highly efficient, as demonstrated by top-tier results in Redis SET operations and Passmark database benchmarks. However, write bandwidth for large uncached memory blocks and single-core stress-ng performance remain in the average tier.

Given its high physical core count and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the c9g.12xlarge offers a highly cost-efficient profile for compute-intensive workloads that benefit from dedicated ARM cores without the overhead of simultaneous multithreading. It is highly suited for software compilation, high-throughput web serving, database operations, and text processing. The lack of local storage means workloads requiring high-speed local disk I/O must rely on network-attached storage, which is supported by the 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. It is also capable of handling moderate large language model inference tasks, particularly prompt processing for smaller models, though it is not designed for heavy GPU-accelerated AI workloads.
description: Amazon Web Services c9g.12xlarge is a compute-optimized server featuring 48 dedicated physical cores built on the ARM64 AWS Graviton Neoverse-V3 architecture. Operating at 3.3 GHz, the processor provides 48 vCPUs with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, supported by 96.0 GB of system memory. The server utilizes the AWS Nitro hypervisor, delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps, and does not include local storage or GPU hardware. Benchmark data highlights top-tier performance in software compilation, text processing, Redis SET operations, and static web serving. It also demonstrates strong memory read bandwidth and multi-core decompression capabilities. This server is highly cost-efficient for compute-bound workloads, making it an excellent fit for high-throughput web serving, database operations, CI/CD pipelines, and lightweight language model inference.
